verdict.rationale: Paperspace's docs are hosted on docs.digitalocean.com, and a probe found a live llms.txt there (HTTP 200). However, it is a DigitalOcean-wide index, and the pack does not confirm it covers the Paperspace sections. The markdown variant of the Paperspace docs page returned 404, and no OpenAPI spec was found at the candidate paths, so agent-oriented docs support is thin. Missing for 10: confirmed Paperspace-specific llms.txt coverage, markdown docs endpoints, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of agent use.
